title: Range Slice B numeric input visibility and sizing
purpose: Implement the range audit's numeric-input slice without adding broad range customization.
objective: Make numeric inputs an explicit range subelement with visibility, side placement, and vertical width contracts.
scope_boundary: In scope: Elementor controls for input visibility, vertical side placement, numeric input width, wrapper classes, CSS show/hide/width behavior, and mechanical verification. Out of scope: custom dual-range engine, selected-track overlay, tick count controls, handle icons, and final visual approval.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-018 is done and the plugin worktree is clean.
exit_condition: Range number inputs can be hidden without reserving layout, and vertical input width/side placement are explicit.
completion_criteria: Range inputs remain visible by default for existing widgets.
Hidden inputs do not reserve the large vertical rail.
Vertical input side placement is represented by stable wrapper classes.
Range sync and reset behavior still use the existing JS contract.
No deferred range controls are implemented in this slice.

phases.title: Controls and markup
phases.purpose: Add Elementor controls and range wrapper classes.

phases.title: CSS contract
phases.purpose: Hide input rail cleanly and constrain vertical input width.

phases.title: Verification
phases.purpose: Run syntax/diff checks and record QA boundary.

acceptance_criteria: No plugin source outside range render/style/CSS is changed unless verification proves it necessary.
Guilherme visual QA remains required for final craft approval.
verification: Plugin PHP lint, JS syntax check, Composer validation, and diff checks pass.
stop_conditions: The slice starts implementing a custom range engine.
The change breaks current min/max value synchronization.
